parameters.content:
📥 INGESTION

Reads all PDF files from the Docker-mounted input directory:
/files/input-pdfs

The file selector supports multiple PDFs using the pattern:
/files/input-pdfs/*.pdf

📄 PDF TEXT EXTRACTION

Converts each PDF file into plain text using n8n's native PDF extraction.

This works best with digital PDFs that contain selectable text.
✂️ Splits each PDF text into individual invoices using the repeated invoice header as a marker. Produces one n8n item per invoice/page.

options.system: You are an invoice data extraction assistant. Return only valid JSON. Do not use Markdown. Do not include explanations or any text outside the JSON object. Convert numeric values to numbers without thousands separators.

parameters.content:
🤖 AI DATA EXTRACTION

Claude Haiku reads each invoice text block and extracts structured invoice data as valid JSON.

🧹 JSON NORMALIZATION

Parses the LLM text response into real n8n JSON and prepares the data for validation and database persistence.
